title: Dublin in Infrared
summary: A reproducible Sentinel-2 workflow revealing patterns of photosynthetic vegetation across Dublin.
hero_alt: NDVI map of Dublin showing vegetated areas in green and built or bare areas in warm neutral colors
question: Where does the Sentinel-2 visible and near-infrared response indicate vigorous photosynthetic vegetation within the Dublin study window?
study_area: Dublin, Ireland; approximately 19 × 27 km around the city and surrounding coastline.
outcome: A masked NDVI surface and distribution summary derived directly from red and near-infrared reflectance bands.
role: Demonstration workflow: cloud-hosted raster access, band calculation, cloud/nodata masking, and cartographic output with Python.

methods.title: Windowed read
methods.text: Read only the Dublin extent from Sentinel-2 L2A red (B04), near-infrared (B08), and scene classification cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs.

methods.title: Mask
methods.text: Remove nodata and scene classes for cloud shadows, clouds, cirrus, and snow/ice before calculating the index.

methods.title: Calculate
methods.text: Compute NDVI = (NIR − Red) / (NIR + Red) with NumPy, guarding against zero denominators and invalid observations.

methods.title: Map & summarize
methods.text: Display NDVI from −1 to +1, export a downsampled web raster, and summarize valid pixel values with a histogram.

maps.title: Vegetation index
maps.alt: Map of NDVI over Dublin calculated from Sentinel-2 imagery
maps.caption: Higher positive NDVI generally indicates more vigorous photosynthetic vegetation. Values near water and built surfaces are usually lower.

maps.title: Value distribution
maps.alt: Histogram showing the distribution of valid NDVI values in the Dublin study area
maps.caption: Distribution of valid, masked pixels in the study window; percentages describe this sample only.

data.name: Sentinel-2 L2A — S2A_29UPV_20240421_0_L2A
data.details: Bands B04 and B08 at 10 m source resolution; SCL at 20 m. Acquired 21 April 2024 at 11:36 UTC; scene cloud cover 2.81%.
